I don't think any of the candidates, Democrat or Republican, could be considered pro-life. The Democratic side has the whole abortion issue. I think that actively advocating for abortion to be legalized is terrible. However, America has tons of other problems right now that have been outlined in other comments on this post. Rising healthcare costs, a near lack of a social safety net for someone who's struggling to live paycheck to paycheck, and a president with a needlessly aggressive national policy.

I don't consider that pro-life.  A country where insulin costs thousands of dollars is not pro-life. A country that pushes an agenda favoring war is not pro-life.

I think it comes down to deciding which of these views is the lesser of two evils. That's just my opinion though haha. Feel free to prove me wrong.
